'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man is killed and several others are injured by [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] in [[Turmus Ayya]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-65973383 (BBC News)]
**An Israeli [[Drone warfare|drone]] conducts the first [[airstrike]] on the [[West Bank]] since 2005, targeting a car, and killing two [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad|PIJ]] members and an [[Al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigades]] member. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/palestinian-car-west-bank-struck-israeli-drone-strike (Middle East Eye)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Food and Drug Administration|U.S. Food and Drug Administration]] approves [[Upside Foods]] and [[Eat Just|Good Meat]]'s applications to commercially sell [[Cultured meat|lab-grown meat]], making the United States the second country in the world to allow its sale after [[Singapore]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/21/a-new-era-lab-grown-meat-gets-approval-for-sale-in-us (Al Jazeera)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Paris explosion]]
**Around 50 people are injured and one is missing after an [[explosion]] and fire on [[Rue Saint-Jacques, Paris|Rue Saint-Jacques]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/06/22/europe/paris-gas-explosion-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2023 Canary Islands migrant boat disaster]]
**At least 35 people are missing after a dinghy carrying migrants sinks off the coast of the [[Canary Islands]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/one-child-dead-24-people-rescued-dinghy-sinks-en-route-spains-canary-islands-2023-06-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Yinchuan gas explosion]]
**Thirty-one people are killed and seven others are injured by a [[gas explosion]] at a restaurant in [[Yinchuan]], [[China]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/06/21/china/ningxia-barbecue-restaurant-explosion-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*Two people are killed and 31 others are injured by a [[train crash]] near [[M'saken]], [[Sousse Governorate]], [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/06/21/tunisia-train-derailment-kills-two-injures-34/ (Africanews)]
*Four people are killed and several others are injured after a tornado rips through the town of [[Matador, Texas| Matador]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/tornado-texass-matador-leaves-least-three-dead-nyt-2023-06-22/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Morocco relations]]
**[[Morocco]] cancels this year's [[Negev Summit]] meeting in response to [[Israel]] approving the construction of over 4,500 settlements in the occupied [[West Bank]] on Sunday. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/morocco-suspends-negev-summit-israeli-settlement-expansion (Middle East Eye)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people are injured in a stabbing at the [[Central Middlesex Hospital]] in [[Park Royal]], [[London]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/armed-police-attending-incident-london-hospital-uk-police-2023-06-21/ (Reuters)]
*A court in [[Belarus]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] 18 participants who took part in the [[2020–2021 Belarusian protests|2020 election protests]] against President [[Alexander Lukashenko]] to between 2 and 25 years imprisonment. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-lukashenko-election-protests-2020-opposition-prison-cba09f0a7b7de555262f9bcd7e339f96 (AP)]
*Russian prosecutor-general [[Igor Krasnov]] designates international non-governmental organization [[World Wide Fund for Nature]] (WWF) as an "[[Russian undesirable organizations law|undesirable organization]]", effectively prohibiting the organization from operating in the country. Krasnov claims that WWF's campaigns threaten [[Economy of Russia|Russian economic development]], particularly in the [[Energy in Russia|energy sector]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-bans-wwf-citing-threats-fossil-fuel-campaigns-2023-06-21/ (Reuters)]
